channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Aliados de Lula comemoram vazamentos na íntegra sobre Lulinha
item.description: Lula's allies celebrated the full leak of the PF report on Lulinha and Marcola's ties to lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, betting that full disclosure will avoid further scandals during the campaign. They also welcomed the PGR statement that does not confirm any deal between the government and the so-called Careca do INSS, helping to contextualize the case.

item.title: Defesa da amiga de Lulinha pede paralisação do inquérito a Mendonça
item.description: The defense of lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, requested the suspension of the Supreme Court investigation into alleged influence peddling in the Lula administration. The lawyers claimed irregularities in the evidence gathered during the probe.

item.title: Mendonça tende a manter no STF inquéritos sobre Lulinha
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça is likely to keep the inquiries into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) and a lobbyist at the STF, rejecting the transfer requested by the PGR, as messages mention authorities with privileged jurisdiction. The decision follows criticism of the PGR and PF's handling of the investigation.

item.title: Durigan diz que enfoque em eventual novo mandato de Lula será fim da 6 x 1 e redução de juros
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan stated that, in a potential new term for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, priorities would include ending the 6x1 scale and reducing interest rates. He highlighted these as economic focuses for the coming years.

item.title: Quartas de final da Sul-Americana: veja o chaveamento e as datas dos confrontos
item.description: The 2026 Copa Sudamericana advances to the quarterfinals with four Brazilian clubs: São Paulo, Santos, Atlético-MG, and Vasco. The matchups are set, highlighted by São Paulo vs. Boca Juniors and Atlético-MG vs. Santos, while Vasco awaits River Plate or Independiente Santa Fe. The tournament represents a chance at a title and a spot in the 2027 Libertadores.

item.title: Mansão usada por Lulinha foi alugada por testemunha da Lava Jato
item.description: Federal Police investigate the rental of a mansion in Brasília, allegedly hired for Fábio Luís da Silva, known as Lulinha, with documents signed by Rafael Nicolau Arbex. The investigation is linked to three inquiries at the Supreme Court, including suspected influence peddling and corruption in the INSS. Roberta Luchsinger, who rented the property, was a witness in the Car Wash operation.

item.title: O elo entre a mansão usada por Lulinha e o sítio de Atibaia
item.description: Dentist Rafael Nicolau Arbex, a Lava Jato witness, appears as a link between the mansion used by Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) and the Atibaia site tied to a conviction of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The investigation gathers corruption elements involving relatives and political allies.

item.title: 'Fora da bolha': Lulinha nas manchetes, picanha e bets na campanha e o factoide de Marçal
item.description: The third episode of 'Fora da Bolha' discusses investigations involving Lula's son and a lobbyist, creating pressure on the PT campaign for re-election. The video also covers the disagreement between PGR and STF regarding jurisdiction, along with topics like cost of living, debt, online betting, and Pablo Marçal's entry into the presidential race. Analysts comment on electoral strategies and the impact of these factors on the crystallized electorate.

item.title: Lula anuncia investimentos de R$ 2,3 bilhões em inteligência artificial
item.description: President Lula announced R$ 2.3 billion in AI investments, including a supercomputer, Chinese tech partnerships, and chip development. The initiative aims to boost Brazil's technological autonomy and train 3,000 professionals.

item.title: Zema defende tarifa mínima para motoboys e cobra respeito de aplicativos
item.description: Presidential candidate Romeu Zema (Novo) defended on Thursday (20th) the creation of a minimum fare for motorcycle courier delivery workers, emphasizing the need for respect and protection of workers. He highlighted that delivery personnel need to be valued and institutionalized with a guaranteed minimum fare.

item.title: Mendonça manda retirar vídeo de IA que associa Flávio a Vorcaro
item.description: Minister André Mendonça of the TSE ordered the removal of an AI-generated video linking Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) to former Banco Master owner Daniel Vorcaro. The decision cited deepfake indicators and ruled that labeling the content as 'satire' is insufficient to justify its spread. The judge emphasized the need to combat disinformation in the electoral context.

item.title: Agenda dos candidatos: presidenciáveis concentram atos em São Paulo, Rio e Minas
item.description: On Friday (21), leading presidential candidates hold campaign events in the Southeast region. Lula (PT) heads to Minas Gerais with stops in Governador Valadares and a rally in Belo Horizonte. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) focuses activities in Rio de Janeiro, with a rally in Nova Iguaçu and a caravan in Duque de Caxias. Candidates Caiado (PSD), Zema (Novo), Renan (Missão), and Cury (Avante) also campaign in São Paulo and surrounding cities.

item.title: Líder do governo Lula pede à PF e à PGR informações sobre investigação do filme 'Dark Horse'
item.description: Teresa Leitão, leader of Lula's government in the Senate, filed requests for information to the Federal Police and the Attorney General's Office regarding investigations involving Flávio Bolsonaro, including the funding of the film 'Dark Horse' and a legal dispute over a mansion in Angra dos Reis. The PT seeks to counter the crisis involving Lula with attacks on the MDB affiliate.

item.title: Depois de Marcola, Lula passou pente-fino no Planalto para descartar pagamentos de lobista
item.description: Following the scandal involving Lula's son and former chief of staff Marcola, Lula conducted an investigation at Planalto Palace to rule out payments from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger. The searches did not identify new beneficiaries, though some cases remained under suspicion. The lawyer for Lula's son stated there is nothing irregular in the process.

item.title: Defesa de amiga de Lulinha pede a Mendonça fim de investigação sobre suposto tráfico de influência em negócios com o governo Lula
item.description: The defense of businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger asked the STF to shelve an inquiry into alleged irregularities involving President Lula's son, Fábio Luís. The PGR requested that the case be moved to first instance court, while the defense claims evidence was obtained illegally during a PF operation. The case involves suspicions of influence peddling in government business deals.

item.title: Flávio foge de explicar e tenta sepultar caso Vorcaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential candidate from PL, refuses to clarify the millions received from banker Daniel Vorcaro, claiming the case is 'a closed page'. After nearly 100 days of silence, he attempts to redirect press focus toward investigations involving Lula's son. The premiere of 'Dark Horse', a film about his trajectory, was postponed to after the elections, fearing renewed scrutiny over the Vorcaro case.

item.title: Crusoé: Lulinha lá
item.description: Federal Police investigations into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, could become a political obstacle for the PT's reelection bid. New revelations involving the president's son's messages expand the investigation focus.

item.title: “Game of Thrones” no STF, caso Lulinha e Master atravessam a eleição de 2026
item.description: The Lulinha case, investigated at the STF for INSS frauds, is an unknown for Lula's government in 2026, as its electoral impact remains unclear. Meanwhile, the Court faces an internal dispute over future composition, with three to five seats at stake from 2027. These cases may influence both the presidential election and the dominant bloc within the Supreme Court.

item.title: Lulinha tinha “comunhão de interesses econômicos” com lobista, diz PF
item.description: The Federal Police reported to the Supreme Court that Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, the son of President Lula, allegedly shared economic interests with lobbyist Roberta Luchtsinger in a scheme involving attempts to secure federal contracts, particularly in the medical cannabis sector. The investigation suggests possible influence peddling, with suspicious negotiations and payments to public officials.

item.title: ‘É uma das maiores crises humanitárias do país’, diz Damares sobre mortes de Yanomamis
item.description: Senator Damares Alves leads a Senate committee to investigate the alleged misappropriation of funds intended for the Yanomami people, highlighting a humanitarian crisis under Lula's administration. Over 2 billion reais were allocated, yet part of the funds disappeared, leading to increased deaths and violence in the villages.

item.title: Senado no RS: Manuela d’Ávila lidera e 2ª vaga tem empate técnico
item.description: Manuela d'Ávila (PSol) leads the Senate race in Rio Grande do Sul with 33.6%, according to Paraná Pesquisas. There is a technical tie for the second seat between Marcel Van Hattem (Novo), Rigotto (MDB), and Pimenta (PT), with a margin of error of 2.6 points. The survey interviewed 1,504 voters and is registered with the TSE.

item.title: Governo Lula: leia a agenda de ministros do governo nesta 6ª feira
item.description: On Friday (August 21, 2026), federal government officials have scheduled commitments in Brasília, São Paulo, Pernambuco, Minas Gerais, and Alagoas, covering topics such as labor relations, transportation infrastructure, ports, and rural development. While the article lists only five ministers with publicly disclosed agendas, it highlights the lack of information for 33 out of the 38 federal ministers, without any official explanation.

item.title: Zucco e Juliana Brizola empatam pelo governo do RS, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Paraná Pesquisas survey, registered with the TSE, shows Zucco (PL) at 34.4% and Juliana Brizola (PDT) at 31.4% in the race for Rio Grande do Sul governor. The study of 1,504 interviews has a margin of error of ±2.6 points and was funded by the PL party.

item.title: Manuela d’Ávila lidera disputa pelo Senado no RS
item.description: A Paraná Pesquisas survey registered with the TSE shows Manuela d’Ávila (Psol) leading the RS Senate race with 33.6% of voting intentions. Other candidates — Marcel van Hattem (26.9%), Rigotto (24.3%), and Pimenta (22.5%) — are technically tied for the second seat, with a 2.6-point margin of error. Two senators will be elected in 2026.

item.title: Artigo: Bets, danos à sociedade e economia comportamental
item.description: The rise of online betting in Brazil has sparked societal concern and debates over regulation, with criticism from figures like Lula and Zema. Legalization in 2018 and regulation in 2023, including proposals for bans, were challenged for insufficient protection of mental health and the economy, as seen in STF cases. In 2025, bets reached R$220.6 billion, with R$36.9 billion in losses for bettors.

item.title: 49,2% aprovam e 47,8% desaprovam governo de Eduardo Leite no RS
item.description: A survey by Paraná Pesquisas, released on August 21, 2026, shows that 49.2% of Rio Grande do Sul voters approve of Governor Eduardo Leite's (PSD) management, while 47.8% disapprove. The poll interviewed 1,504 people between August 18 and 20, with a margin of error of ±2.6 points and 95% confidence, and was registered with the TSE under number RS-03898/2026, funded by the PL party.

item.title: As descobertas da PF nas investigações sobre Lulinha
item.description: The Federal Police, authorized by Minister André Mendonça, decrypted communications of lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger revealing alleged billionaire frauds in the pension system and parallel negotiations involving Fábio Lula, son of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The investigation points to a suspected hidden partnership between Lulinha, Luchsinger and businessman Fernando Bittar to exploit favors in the federal government. Recovered deleted messages suggest corruption, influence peddling and public resource misappropriation.

item.title: SP vê disputa que o Brasil adiou
item.description: The São Paulo gubernatorial race between Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad shows greater programmatic depth compared to the national campaigns of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, which are described as personalized. The article emphasizes the relevance of São Paulo politics as a reference for national debate.

item.title: Lula terá maior tempo de TV na eleição; Flávio Bolsonaro aparece em segundo
item.description: President Lula (PT) will have the largest amount of free electoral advertising time in the 2026 elections, with 5 minutes and 31 seconds daily on radio and TV. Flávio Bolsonaro ranks second in the distribution of advertising time granted by the TSE.

item.title: Mortes no território Yanomami disparam no governo Lula e superam gestão Bolsonaro
item.description: Between 2023 and 2025, the Lula administration recorded 1,121 indigenous deaths in Yanomami territory, surpassing the 951 registered during Bolsonaro's term in the same period. The crisis, driven by disease and organized crime, prompted Supreme Court Justice Edson Fachin to request a joint mission to the region with Senator Damares Alves.

item.title: Entenda como uma crise global moldou o uso do GLP no Brasil
item.description: A 1990 geopolitical crisis triggered by Iraq's invasion of Kuwait led to soaring oil prices and GLP shortages in Brazil, prompting the 1991 ban on non-domestic uses of LPG. Despite market normalization, restrictions persisted for decades until 2026, when Law No. 15,348 decriminalized expanded LPG use, now pending ANP regulation.

item.title: Nas sombras
item.description: Fernando Cerimedo, a far-right operative accused of conspiring in the Bolsonaro coup, was arrested in Bolivia for hiring hitmen to kill Nadia Beller, a MAS activist. The case exposes transnational networks of disinformation and political violence tied to far-right groups across Latin America.

item.title: Plano de governo de Lula em 2026 troca “reconstrução” por legado
item.description: Lula's 2026 government plan shifts from the 'reconstruction' narrative of 2022 to emphasizing the legacy of his third term, highlighting already delivered results and expanding from 33 to 84 pages.

item.title: 425 candidatos recebem o Bolsa Família; 3 têm bens acima de R$ 1 milhão
item.description: A Poder360 survey found that 425 candidates running in the 2026 elections receive Bolsa Famíria, including three with assets over R$1 million. The analysis cross-references federal and electoral court data, suggesting potential misuse of public funds, though fraud cannot be confirmed.

item.title: Maranhão terá eleição simulada no domingo para testar urnas
item.description: The municipality of Paulino Neves, in Maranhão, will hold a simulated election on Sunday (August 23, 2026) to test the electronic voting system, with approximately 15,000 voters participating. This initiative, conducted by the TSE and TRE-MA since 2004, aims to validate the security, speed, and operation of voting machines and poll workers before the official October elections.

item.title: Os ‘postes’ de Bolsonaro: família, aliados e imitadores exploram o sobrenome nas urnas em 2026
item.description: The Bolsonaro family and 21 unrelated candidates use the surname in the 2026 elections, turning it into an electoral asset. The term 'poste', originating in 2010, gains new relevance to describe candidates associated with influential political figures.

item.title: Investigações contra Lulinha devem continuar no STF?
item.description: The National Public Ministry has requested the transfer of two investigations against Fábio Lulinha, son of President Lula, from the STF to the lower court, claiming the investigations do not involve authorities with special jurisdiction. The cases remain under secrecy and are being processed in the office of Minister André Mendonça, while a third investigation remains undecided regarding jurisdiction change.

item.title: 'Trackings' mostram acirramento da disputa entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Datafolha polls show increasing tension in the 2026 presidential race between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro. Both campaigns are preparing for reactions to the results, with key issues including economy, security, and corruption. There is high public anticipation to see how voters respond to the electoral scenario.

item.title: Aliado: Lula não fará campanha na defensiva e vai desconstruir Flávio na TV
item.description: Lula avoids defensive campaign and plans to counter Flávio Bolsonaro's criticism on TV, according to new article. Faced with pressure from news involving his eldest son, the president chooses to directly attack the opponent.

item.title: Dono de jatinho que levou Toffoli é o candidato mais rico; veja ranking
item.description: Luiz Osvaldo Pastore, from PL, is the wealthiest candidate in 2026 after declaring R$677.7 million to the TSE. He is Eduardo Gomes' first alternate in the Senate race for Tocantins. His wealth raises questions about economic influence in politics.

item.title: Extrema-direita mira o Senado para perseguir ministros do STF em 2027, alerta professor
item.description: The Brazilian far-right aims to secure a Senate majority in 2026 to pursue Supreme Court justices in 2027, warns law professor Daniel Capecchi Nunes. Senators have the constitutional power to prosecute and convict ministers for responsibility crimes, and a majority could be used to pressure judges. Jair Bolsonaro has previously stated he would rather lead than the President of the Republic if he controlled Congress.

item.title: Deepfakes em perfis de apoio a Lula e Flávio somam milhões de interações e testam regras do TSE
item.description: Deepfakes on pro-Lula and Flávio profiles generate millions of interactions, testing TSE rules that require disclosure but where 22 of 25 identified videos lacked such identification. These contents are used to attack rivals or praise candidates, sparking debate on regulatory thresholds.

item.title: Ex-comandante da FAB revela em livro carta que fez para divulgar em caso de golpe de Estado em 2022
item.description: Former FAB commander Carlos Almeida Baptista Junior reveals in his book 'I Said No!' that he prepared a letter to publish in case of a 2022 coup. He describes the 'psychological war' during Bolsonaro's government and warns about the 'institutional abyss' threatening Brazilian democracy.

item.title: Eleições de 2026: quando é a data do primeiro e segundo turno?
item.description: The 2026 general elections in Brazil will be held in two rounds: the first on October 4 and the second, if necessary, on October 25. The campaign begins on August 16, with free television and radio advertising starting on August 28. The president-elect will take office on January 5, 2027, and the governors-elect on January 6.

item.title: Quando começa a propaganda eleitoral na TV e no rádio?
item.description: Free electoral broadcasting on TV and radio begins on August 28, following the start of the campaign on August 16. The 2026 elections take place on October 4 (first round) and October 25 (second round). Campaigns must follow the calendar and times set by the TSE.

item.title: Cury mostra que "fenômeno Marçal" não será repetido facilmente
item.description: Augusto Cury, candidate for the Presidency by Avante, has 8.3 million Instagram followers, but despite this, he doesn't significantly grow in voting intention polls, ranging between 1% and 2%. Unlike Pablo Marçal, who managed to turn his digital popularity into political identity, Cury cannot replicate this phenomenon, even with expressive online engagement numbers.

item.title: Em 5 dias, DF tem 100 denúncias de propaganda eleitoral irregular
item.description: In just five days of the electoral campaign in the Federal District, the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) received 100 reports of irregular campaign ads through the Pardal app. Most complaints involve irregularities in public advertising, followed by online ads and stickers on vehicles. The most reported positions are district and federal deputy and governor, while the presidency was mentioned in only one complaint.

item.title: Acusações sobre Flávio viram munição petista em reação ao caso Lulinha
item.description: Allegations regarding Lula's ties to businessman Lulinha and lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger were used as ammunition by PT supporters to pressure Flávio Bolsonaro over the R$61 million payment to Banco Master for the film 'Dark Horse'. During the first week of campaigning, Flávio claimed the matter was 'water under the bridge' and that 'Lula is the one who must give an account,' prompting criticism from campaign members who accused him of lying. The electoral climate was marked by mutual attacks and contradictions about transparency and accountability.

item.title: Flávio silencia sobre R$ 61 milhões e desvia foco para Lulinha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro avoids commenting on the whereabouts of R$61 million donated for a film glorifying his father and shifts focus to Lula's son, Fábio Luiz, and an investigated lobbyist. The Public Ministry concludes no business deals were finalized in the ongoing Supreme Court inquiry.

item.title: Confira agenda dos candidatos ao governo de SP nesta sexta (21/8)
item.description: São Paulo gubernatorial candidates continue their campaign schedules on the sixth day of electoral activities, highlighting Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad. The agenda features walks, interviews, and party events in the metropolitan region.
